_comment: Spec v1 s9 -- every path in this repo belongs to exactly one class.
TOOL    = code, docs and metrics ABOUT the tools. Public, hand-written, no data.
FIXTURE = synthetic tests and examples. This repo ships none.
DATA    = real-run outputs, versioned in a PRIVATE companion repository, never the public tool tree.
_audited: 2026-10-02. The data list is empty because this repo produces no real-run output, not because
nobody looked. It holds three checker scripts and a shared Markdown parser.
Checked rather than assumed. Every write in shipped (non-test) code was located:
dash_guard.py --fix -> rewrites the file it was pointed at, which is the CALLER's source.
That is an edit to somebody else's tree, not output this repo makes.
load_budget.py      -> prints. It writes nothing at all.
doc_contract.py     -> bounded admitted documentation/metadata reads and prints only; no real-run output.
There is no ledger, runs tree, dated output or database.
_run_shape_probes stays empty for the same reason: a probe list names what a real run of THIS
repo writes, and a real run of this repo writes nothing.
